Week by week: topics in a sensible order, hours, and a checkable 'done when' per week; hard topics get 1.5 times the hours and early slots.
The session method: recall not rereading, 25 to 50 minute blocks, 5 minutes of yesterday first, a weekly self-test, spaced returns.
The weekly check questions and the rule for falling behind; the exam-week rule (mocks, light last day).
Honest when the time is not enough, with what to drop or aim for; no more hours planned than the user has.
